ranked.headline: Generative and graph deep learning resolve transcriptomic structure across platforms
ranked.summary: Spatial and multimodal transcriptomics datasets now demand integration and deconvolution methods that transfer across tissues and technologies.

ranked.headline: Sequencing-based inference of epigenomic features checked against independent truth
ranked.summary: New tools for single-cell methylation, cfDNA methylation, and longitudinal scRNA-seq appear alongside benchmarks of existing assays against reference data.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence models adapted to PTM, variant, and regulatory prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers layer biological priors and sparse features onto pretrained protein and DNA encoders.

ranked.headline: Simulation and likelihood frameworks link dynamical models to biological mechanism
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply simulation-based inference and coupled model components to cortical, cell-cortex, and Physarum dynamics.

ranked.headline: Automated tools and benchmarks quantify high-dimensional cellular and spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Five recent preprints and publications pair automated quantitative methods with annotated datasets, benchmarks, and baseline comparisons for cellular data.

ranked.headline: LLMs and agents are being grounded in verifiable single-cell and genomic analysis tools
ranked.summary: Evaluation frameworks for LLM agents and single-cell perturbation models are now appearing alongside knowledge-grounded annotation and workflow tools.

ranked.headline: ML models infer tumor molecular states from imaging, histology, omics, and plasma data
ranked.summary: Multimodal ML is moving tumor molecular inference from MRI, blood, and tissue toward candidate biomarkers, supported by new multi-omic resources.

ranked.headline: Software tools link variant calls, disease gene panels and learned pathogenicity scores
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications present tools for variant interpretation across immunology, oncology, cardiology, and gene panel curation.

ranked.headline: Inference choices shape which biomolecular conformational states are sampled
ranked.summary: Recent generative, Bayesian-steered, and enhanced-sampling methods extend structural inference to PTM-driven dynamics and disordered ensembles.

ranked.headline: Deep models condition on biological context beyond the molecule itself
ranked.summary: Six May 2026 papers pair molecular models with transcriptomic, protein, structural, and activity-profile inputs for prediction and design.

ranked.headline: Pangenome assemblies and sibling IBD data map mutation and mobile element variation
ranked.summary: Long-read pangenome assemblies and sibling-based mutation calling now resolve human variation in mutation rates, LINE-1 elements and NUMTs.

ranked.headline: Recovering single-cell dynamics from live imaging, morphology, and splicing kinetics
ranked.summary: Live-imaging, morphological, and splicing-based models now infer cell fate dynamics from measurements that are usually static or sparsely sampled in time.

ranked.headline: Conditioned diffusion and agentic search steer sequence design toward explicit targets
ranked.summary: Recent May 2026 preprints extend generative sequence design to GPCR binders, enzymes, RNA, PTM-aware proteins and polymers under explicit control.

ranked.headline: Agents and causal methods turn biomedical literature into computable structured records
ranked.summary: Human-in-the-loop agentic workflows are now being applied to extract assay, model, and causal evidence from unstructured biomedical literature.

ranked.headline: Modeling measurement artifacts and noise within biological parameter inference
ranked.summary: Bayesian and neural-network inference methods now address missed events, timing uncertainty, and noise in dynamical biological models.

ranked.headline: Single-cell tools infer regulatory networks and cell interactions across perturbations
ranked.summary: Database-free and regulatory-model inference is now applied to perturbation-scale and cross-species single-cell datasets.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links genetic variants to regulatory and HLA-I presentation readouts
ranked.summary: Models now move beyond variant pathogenicity scores toward quantitative, cell-type-resolved regulatory and presentation readouts.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link physical and chemical processes to discrete spatial outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published multiscale tumour model couple geometry and force balance to discrete outcomes like detachment and separation.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks encode domain priors for biological network prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply graph learning to PPI, drug-target, driver gene, and biomarker prediction, embedding domain structure into models.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings from bacterial sequences predict operons, abundance, and promoters
ranked.summary: Genomic and protein language model embeddings are now applied to bacterial prediction tasks spanning operons, communities, and regulatory sequences.

ranked.headline: LLM and agent frameworks now drive generative molecular and genetic circuit design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 journal paper pair LLM generators with chemistry tools, verifiers, and multi-objective optimization for design tasks.

ranked.headline: Molecular dynamics resolves membrane and pH-dependent residue energetics in proteins
ranked.summary: Unbiased and constant-pH simulations now quantify environment-dependent residue energetics in bilayers and across pH-titrated protein states.

ranked.headline: Constraint-based and learned models reconstruct and simulate microbial metabolism
ranked.summary: Learned enzyme and molecule representations are now paired with constraint-based simulation to annotate metabolic function across scales.

ranked.headline: Adaptive parameters and feedback reshape neural and metabolic system dynamics
ranked.summary: Adaptive feedback and learnable dynamical parameters are now tested directly in RNNs, metabolic ODE models, and whole-brain neural mass models.

ranked.headline: Microbial gene families mapped to host, habitat, substrate, and chemosensory context
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply genome-scale and metagenomic profiling to map enzyme, chemosensory, and degradation gene families across microbial lineages.

ranked.headline: Computational tools map PAM/TAM motifs and guide RNAs for CRISPR and base editing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published resource expand computational PAM, TAM, and base-editor guide design for genome editing experiments.

ranked.headline: Statistical inference and bias correction in sequencing-based genomic measurements
ranked.summary: Large sequencing resources such as TCGA and ENCODE show sample-specific and regional biases, prompting correction and inference methods.

ranked.headline: Sequencing tools validated against real nanopore reads and simulated benchmarks
ranked.summary: Simulated reads still miss the full Nanopore error profile, prompting tools for repeats, haplotypes, and transmission inference.

ranked.headline: Scoring method agreement and analytical choices as quantities in omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints score link confidence, demultiplexing concordance and preprocessing choices instead of treating them as fixed assumptions.

ranked.headline: Metagenomic pipelines diverge in resistome detection; new tools add quality checks
ranked.summary: Up to 45-fold ARG count differences across ten pipelines make tool choice a direct determinant of metagenomic resistome conclusions.

ranked.headline: Curated resources and graph methods link gene sets to disease and cross-species function
ranked.summary: Fragmented gene annotations across databases are being consolidated into source-attributed, queryable resources for disease and translational interpretation.

ranked.headline: Structural and physicochemical features ground benchmarked protein predictors
ranked.summary: Held-out and experimental benchmarks now expose where feature-grounded enzyme, antibody, and protein-stability predictors remain limited.

ranked.headline: Feedback and first-passage timing decouple activation from steady-state output
ranked.summary: Stochastic models now treat promoter feedback and first-passage timing as design variables, separable from mean behavior and steady-state output.

ranked.headline: Automated packaging and modular R and Python tools for reproducible biological analysis
ranked.summary: Reproducible biological analysis increasingly depends on automated packaging, dependency resolution, and scalable workflow backends across R, Python, and Linux…

ranked.headline: IsomiR-resolved analysis of targeting, read denoising, and vesicle cellular origin
ranked.summary: isomiR-level resolution now extends to target prediction, read denoising, and extracellular vesicle provenance in small RNA-seq data.

ranked.headline: Sequencing pipelines for measles, Andes virus and malaria genomes
ranked.summary: Sequencing pipelines are being evaluated for surveillance and preparedness across measles, Andes virus and Plasmodium falciparum.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings add structural context to residue and genome annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair ESM-2 embeddings with predicted structures to resolve cysteine chemical states and cross-species gene assignments.

ranked.headline: Computational studies map RNA conformational plasticity, protein contacts and docking
ranked.summary: Recent simulations, torsional analyses and docking benchmarks are sharpening computational models of RNA conformation and recognition.

ranked.headline: Open proteomics software automates QC, corona analysis, and PTM quantification roll-up
ranked.summary: Proteomics steps from instrument QC to peptide-to-protein roll-up are being packaged as scripted, automated workflows for routine analysis.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies of quail, red algae and a lizard reveal new reference genomes
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved and chromosome-level assemblies now extend contiguous reference genomes to a bird, red algae and a reptile.
